Reviewed corrected interpretation as supplied, no tool use.

2. Stability and completion correctly non-inferred: unstable fields present without experimental opt-in means no runtime stability; `completed` is protocol completion only, task success still requires correlated `threadId`/`turn.id` result plus application outcome. `interrupted/failed/inProgress` correctly excluded.

3. Auth/production correctly bounded: `chatgptAuthTokens` login variant internal-use-only, no TIYE use approved; separate SIWC/Responses-provider routes not prohibited. Commercial access unresolved, S4/S6 partial, Phase1 HOLD maintained. Offline replay covers client handling only, no production adapter/transport change implied.
